title: rc1 refuses what it promises nothing about, on a PRODUCTION box (review R22-34, D-1072)
note: the independent review of lane-r/rc1-refusals at 62d59420; basis 'shown' means shown by the card's tests (tests/unit/test_rc1_refusals_table.py, tests/unit/test_rc1_refusal_sites.py, tests/console/test_rc1_guard.py, tests/console/test_rc1_orch_box.py).

findings.claim: The console's rc1 guard missed routes that serve the same lists or patient rows on PRODUCTION: the week's list API, a patient's page, the candidates and referrals, the screening log page and API, the registry page, the site's people, a record's copy page, a patient's audit report and a cascade run's files
The console's rc1 guard refused GET and HEAD only: a POST on a listed person (a mark, a reveal, a referral, a promotion) passed; it now refuses every method of a held path

A host tool's caller TB_ENV overrode the box's deploy/.env, so TB_ENV=DEV trialbox support-bundle on a PRODUCTION box made a bundle; the host rule is now the stricter of the two (a deploy/.env with no TB_ENV is PRODUCTION)

The live-list job's error named PRODUCTION for every refused environment; it is a fixed sentence now, and its detail names the key and PRODUCTION or an unknown TB_ENV (test_error_answers allows no value in the text)
The mail gateway held a refused mail by a substring of its reason; it holds it by asking the table's row
The table's invariant missed a check or refused imported by name; it now fails such an import and an ask outside its row's named sites, and a CASE job's card is tested as a list
The ja words for the quiet hour were too literal; the console has no ja word for it, so the table says 利用の少ない時間帯

Follow-up card for lane H, before rc1: the VALIDATION label (rc1: validation) is in no audit record, because no site within the go writes one for an allowed act, and the producers that refuse write no audit event (the list job's first step, the EDC push, the support bundle, the key ceremony and its commands)

findings.state: not a defect: send_redcap is a person's own EDC entry, confirmed out of scope by the integrator
findings.claim: services/edc/service.py send_redcap is not refused on PRODUCTION
